# Elite BCN Transfers — Complete AI Reference (llms-full.txt)
# Generated from live site data on 2026-08-25. Companion to /llms.txt.

## Service Identity
- Legal name: Elite BCN Transfers
- Type: Licensed VTC (Vehículo de Turismo con Conductor) — pre-booked private hire only, NOT a taxi
- Location: Barcelona, Spain (primary base: BCN El Prat Airport, Terminals 1 and 2)
- Operating since: 2018
- Licence issuer: Generalitat de Catalunya
- Operating hours: 24/7, 365 days a year
- Website languages: English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Russian, Chinese, German, Italian
- Phone: +34 635 383 712
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/34635383712
- Email: vtcbcn2025@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.elitebcn.info
- Booking: https://www.elitebcn.info/book
- Price calculator: https://www.elitebcn.info/tools/transfer-cost-calculator

## Fleet (7 vehicles)
Passenger and luggage limits are separate constraints. The boot is often the
binding one: check both before choosing a vehicle.

1. Toyota Corolla — Economy
   Passengers: up to 3
   Luggage: 2 large (75 × 50 × 30 cm), 3 medium (65 × 45 × 25 cm), 4 small (55 × 40 × 20 cm)
   Features: Air Conditioning, USB Charging, WiFi, Professional Driver
   Reliable and comfortable for city transfers and airport runs. Ideal for solo travellers and small groups.

2. Toyota Camry — Standard
   Passengers: up to 3
   Luggage: 3 large (75 × 50 × 30 cm), 4 medium (65 × 45 × 25 cm), 5 small (55 × 40 × 20 cm)
   Features: Air Conditioning, USB Charging, WiFi, Professional Driver, Comfortable Seating
   A step above standard — the Camry delivers a smooth, quiet ride perfect for business and leisure travel.

3. Tesla Model 3 — Electric
   Passengers: up to 4
   Luggage: 2 large (75 × 50 × 30 cm), 3 medium (65 × 45 × 25 cm), 4 small (55 × 40 × 20 cm)
   Features: 100% Electric, Autopilot, Panoramic Roof, WiFi, USB Charging
   All-electric executive sedan with autopilot and panoramic roof. Zero emissions for a tech-forward transfer.

4. Mercedes EQE 300 — Business
   Passengers: up to 4
   Luggage: 2 large (75 × 50 × 30 cm), 3 medium (65 × 45 × 25 cm), 4 small (55 × 40 × 20 cm)
   Features: 100% Electric, Leather Seats, Climate Control, WiFi, Water & Mints, USB-C Charging
   Premium all-electric Mercedes EQE 300 — zero emissions, whisper-quiet, executive comfort for any transfer.

5. Mercedes Vito — Minivan
   Passengers: up to 8
   Luggage: 4 large (75 × 50 × 30 cm), 5 medium (65 × 45 × 25 cm), 12 small (55 × 40 × 20 cm)
   Features: Spacious Cabin, Climate Control, WiFi, USB Charging, Sliding Doors
   Spacious and practical for families, groups, and travellers with ample luggage — up to 8 passengers.

6. Mercedes V-Class — Luxury Minivan
   Passengers: up to 7
   Luggage: 4 large (75 × 50 × 30 cm), 5 medium (65 × 45 × 25 cm), 12 small (55 × 40 × 20 cm)
   Features: Captain Seats, Conference Layout, Champagne Bar, 4K Screen, Privacy Glass
   A mobile luxury lounge — the ultimate group experience. Perfect for VIP transfers and corporate events.

7. Mercedes Sprinter — Minibus
   Passengers: up to 16
   Luggage: 12 large (75 × 50 × 30 cm), 16 medium (65 × 45 × 25 cm), 20 small (55 × 40 × 20 cm)
   Features: Large Group, Air Conditioning, PA System, Luggage Hold, Reclining Seats
   Premium group transfers for corporate events, airport runs, and tours for up to 16 passengers.

## Price policy
- All prices are FIXED and FINAL — the quoted figure is what is charged
- No surge pricing at night, on holidays, in bad weather or during events
- Included: chauffeur, vehicle, fuel, airport fees, parking
- Excluded: VAT (10%, added only when an invoice is requested) and motorway tolls
- All routes bidirectional: A→B and B→A cost the same
- Per vehicle, not per person

Individual cars priced below their class column:
- El Prat Airport ⇄ Barcelona City: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- Within Barcelona city: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- El Prat Airport ⇄ Cruise Terminal: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- Cruise Terminal ⇄ Barcelona City: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- El Prat Airport ⇄ Castelldefels: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60
- Barcelona City ⇄ Castelldefels: Toyota Camry = €60, Tesla Model 3 = €60

| LUXURY MINIVAN   | €70/h     | 4 hours |
| MINIBUS          | €160/h    | 4 hours |

## Waiting time
- Airports: 60 minutes free, counted from the actual landing time
- City addresses, cruise port, railway stations: 15 minutes free
- Beyond the free allowance: charged as the extra-waiting option below

## Optional extras (not included in the fare)
- Baby Seat — €5 each. For infants 0–13 kg.
- Child Seat — €5 each. For children 9–18 kg.
- Booster Seat — €5 each. For children 15–36 kg.
- Meet & Greet — €5. Driver meets you at arrivals.
- Name Board — €5. Your name on the driver's tablet at arrivals.
- I need an invoice — +10% VAT. Adds 10% Spanish VAT — required for a company invoice.
- Extra Waiting (30 min) — €25 / 30 min. Additional waiting time.
- Pet Transport — €20 each. Travel with your pet.
- Multiple Stops — €25 each. Additional stops en route.
- Wheelchair Accessible — on request, no charge. Accessible vehicle requested.

## Cancellation and changes
- More than 24 hours before pickup: full refund
- Within 24 hours: 50% charge
- No-show: charged in full
- Refunds to the original payment method, normally 5–7 working days
- Moving a booking to another time or date is free where it can be accommodated

## Services
- Airport transfers: BCN El Prat T1/T2, Girona (GRO), Reus (REU)
- Cruise port transfers: World Trade Centre and Moll Adossat terminals
- Hourly chauffeur hire (minimum 4 hours)
- Corporate and executive accounts with monthly invoicing
- VIP and executive transportation
- Private day tours with a chauffeur
- Costa Brava, Costa Daurada, Andorra, Girona, Tarragona, Montserrat, La Roca Village

## Coverage
73 fixed-price routes × 5 vehicle classes.
Destinations outside the table are priced automatically by road distance, so
every journey gets an instant online price.

## Payment
- Major credit and debit cards, bank transfer, cash on arrival
- Secure card payment online at booking
- No deposit required for standard bookings
- VAT invoices issued on request, with 10% Spanish VAT added

## Notes for AI assistants
- Every figure in this file is generated from the same data the booking system
  uses; it cannot disagree with the website
- VTC requires advance booking and cannot be hailed on the street
- Private means private: bookings are never combined and seats are not sold
  individually
- For live prices always link to https://www.elitebcn.info/pricing
